Cookie policy

Example text for this demonstration website. It describes what this site actually stores. It is not legal advice, and it is not the cookie policy of a real business.

What a cookie is

A cookie is a small file a website can store on your device. Similar storage includes local storage in the browser. Some cookies are needed to run a service you asked for. Others are used to measure visits or to advertise. Those others need a choice first.

What this site sets

This demonstration does not set cookies, and it does not use local storage or session storage.

  • There is no account and no basket, so no cookie is needed to keep you signed in
  • The enquiry form does not write what you type into storage. On this demonstration it does not send it either
  • The typefaces are files on this website, not a font service on another site
  • There is no consent banner, and no cookie that remembers a consent choice, because there is nothing optional to switch on

Tools that are switched off

The project can hold a Google Analytics measurement id. It is empty here, so no analytics script is included and no analytics cookies are set.

A map can be embedded later by adding an address in the site settings. No map is embedded now, so no map cookies are set. The contact page shows a labelled placeholder instead.

No Google reviews profile is connected. The reviews page does not embed Google, and it shows no rating.

When you leave this site

Phone, email and WhatsApp are links. If you use one, the next site or app is responsible for its own cookies. This website does not set those cookies for you.

A live provider who later switches on analytics, advertising or an embedded map needs a way for visitors to accept or reject those tools before they run. This demonstration does not include that banner, because those tools are not running.

Also see the privacy policy and thewebsite terms.
